Metadata.title: OpenAgriNet
Metadata.description: Open infrastructure for accessible agricultural knowledge

hero.title: Open infrastructure for <accent>accessible agricultural</accent> knowledge
hero.description: OpenAgriNet enables institutions to build, share and deploy trusted agricultural knowledge, so that every farmer can access relevant information in their language.
hero.imageAlt: A farmer using a smartphone in a green paddy field

why.title: Why <accent>OAN,</accent> Why <accent>NOW?</accent>
why.lead:
Agriculture is changing fast. Farmers need trusted information,

in their language, at the right time. OAN makes that possible

accessible.title: Make Agricultural Intelligence Accessible
accessible.description: Bring trusted agricultural knowledge, services and information together so farmers can access what they need, when they need it.

localized.title: Localized Intelligence at Scale
localized.description: Most digital solutions are not designed for regional and local languages/dialects

timely.title: Turn Timely Intelligence into Better Decisions
timely.description: Deliver relevant, contextual and timely insights that help farmers make informed decisions at the moments that matter.

coalition.title: From Fragmentation to Coalition
coalition.description: Connect governments, institutions, innovators and service providers through an open network—enabling farmers to discover the right information, service or provider through a connected experience.

how.title: One network. <accent>Built for many solutions.</accent>
how.description:
OpenAgriNet gives institutions a shared foundation to create

agricultural services for different needs, regions and communities.
how.cue: It starts with reusable building blocks.
how.imageAlt: Connected building blocks representing the OpenAgriNet network

blocks.title: The building blocks that power <accent>OpenAgriNet</accent>
blocks.description:
OpenAgriNet brings together reusable building blocks that help institutions create

agricultural knowledge services for different contexts and communities.
blocks.imageAlt: A farmer using a tablet in a green paddy field

languageAi.title: Language AI
languageAi.description: Farmer-facing interface across voice and text modes

authMemory.title: Authentication & Memory
authMemory.description: Identity, session, and conversational memory layer

inferenceAi.title: Inference AI
inferenceAi.description: Core reasoning engine, split into three functional sub-blocks

beckn.title: Beckn Open Network
beckn.description: N×N interoperability across buyer and seller networks

providerOs.title: Provider OS
providerOs.description: Operating system layer for providers participating in the network

observability.title: Observability
observability.description: Monitoring and observability layer across the system

resolver.title: Resolver
resolver.description: Resolution layer grounded in land and GIS data

scale.title:
A Massive opportunity to shape

a better tomorrow
scale.fact: <lead>26%</lead> of the global labour force works in agriculture
